name: com.unity.multiplayer.tools
description: Adds a suite of tools that improve workflows for multiplayer development

samples.description:
Samples showcasing the different ways of building custom network simulator scenarios.

Note: In order to use these Samples, make sure you have Netcode for GameObjects (com.unity.netcode.gameobjects) 1.1.0 or later and Unity Transport (com.unity.transport) 2.0.0 or later. For more info, please check the Network Simulator documentation: https://docs-multiplayer.unity3d.com/tools/current/tools-network-simulator

_upm.changelog:
### Added

- A warning when more than one Network Simulator is enabled, since they all drive the same network transport and only the most recently enabled one takes effect.

### Fixed

- A NullReferenceException in the NGO adapter on the first Play Mode entry after a domain reload with fast enter playmode (regression in 2.2.9).
- The "Add to Scene" buttons in the Multiplayer Tools window adding a duplicate Network Simulator or Runtime Network Stats Monitor instead of selecting the one already in the scene.
- Disabling a Network Simulator clearing the simulated network conditions of another Network Simulator that was still enabled.
